gen-gf-unkempt-gf-kosugi-maru: Kosugi Maru draws neon-tube letters, glowing in one line thickness, with stroke ends set well apart. Unkempt is the one that shouts, rough and commanding; the body just talks.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-kumbh-sans: Kumbh Sans trims its terminals well short of the bowl, each stroke drawn as if with a fixed pen. Unkempt grabs attention; the body simply carries on.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-lato: Stout, pipe-cleaner strokes give Unkempt away at once. Lato, with wide s curves barely curled in, takes over in the text, and the heading earns its keep when big and brief.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-libre-franklin: Unkempt looks thin yet has no thinner parts, every stroke staying put at the same width. Libre Franklin, with its splayed c terminal, carries a long passage along without fuss.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-line-seed-jp: LINE Seed JP makes its horizontals as heavy as its verticals, with counters the eye slips through. Over a long passage, LINE Seed JP feels approachable and easy to follow, a plain sans under a shouting heading.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-livvic: Commanding is how Unkempt feels, its t keeping crossbar and stem in matching weight. Livvic is the one with no stress in its curves and a generous opening in c, built for quiet reading.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-lunasima: Lunasima reads clean, its c tips never creeping toward touching, and that restraint is the point. Lunasima gives Unkempt, with its horizontals matching verticals, a body that never competes with it.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-lxgw-marker-gothic: LXGW Marker Gothic reads as a plain sans with a wide-open c like a bracelet pulled apart, and a gradient you notice only up close. A longer passage would flow smoothly beneath Unkempt's ruler-drawn line.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-m-plus-1: A t with crossbar and stem of matching weight marks Unkempt out. M PLUS 1, with big open eyes on every e and a, would look lost if the heading were made small.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-m-plus-1p: Unkempt carries a heading with no swelling where curves meet stems, while M PLUS 1p stays open at every curve end. A longer passage would move along easily.
